name: Patola
description: Ikat lozenges: open diamonds whose rows of thread are dyed slightly out of register, so every edge is feathered and drifts across the cloth.

code.style: --rule: ( --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--lozenge); clip-path: @var(--lozenge); -webkit-mask: @var(--odd); mask: @var(--odd); -webkit-transform: translateX(@rn(-9, 9, 1.4)%); transform: translateX(@rn(-9, 9, 1.4)%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-color: @var(--k); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--lozenge); clip-path: @var(--lozenge); -webkit-mask: @var(--even); mask: @var(--even); -webkit-transform: translateX(@rn(-9, 9, 1.4)%); transform: translateX(@rn(-9, 9, 1.4)%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --lozenge: polygon(50.0% 0.0%, 100.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 100.0%, 0.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 0.0%, 28.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 72.0%, 72.0% 50.0%, 50.0% 28.0%, 28.0% 50.0%); --odd: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #000 0 6.25%, transparent 6.25% 12.5%); --even: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 6.25%, #000 6.25% 12.5%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
